$comment: Candidate sources for the uganda-locale observatory, from the 2026-10-17 research pass. NOT data/sources.json: nothing here backs a shipped record yet. A source moves into data/sources.json only when an ingest script actually consumes it. access: DIRECT = scriptable download, MANUAL = a person must click/register, REQUEST = Access to Information request / permission / agreement, PAID, ONSITE = reading room only, DEAD = unreachable on 2026-10-17. tier: core = may enter the CC BY 4.0 dataset, sharealike = separate ODbL/CC BY-SA files, licensed = used under the project's own licence and credentials (cache and analyse privately, publish only derived vectors), displayonly = view or link, never redistribute, citeonly = facts may be cited, files not re-hosted, unknown = licence not stated, ask first.
